constant_tempo.note: ONE rigid grid at ONE FINE-TUNED tempo for the whole song; only DoF = global octave + fine tempo + global phase + rare large vamp-gaps (no small catch-up gaps)

fine_tempo.objective: best-agreement GAPLESS tempo (total<= 0.5s) if one clears 0.80x best agreement, else SLOWEST within min+3s total gap (let a real vamp open, don't smear)

tempo_drift.note: WINDOWED piecewise tempo: the offset ramp is change-point-segmented into DRIFT spans (monotone, materially large, well-fit) vs CONSTANT spans (flat); a smooth line per drift span, held constant elsewhere, stitched into ONE continuous offset model. Applied only if a re-place self-check improves coverage-weighted agreement (else reverted). Whole-song drift = the 1-segment case; a big non-monotone span => erratic (rubato, declined).
